ARC1801I.pattern: ^FAST REPLICATION (?<fr_function>.+?) IS STARTING FOR (?<fr_scope>COPY POOL|VOLUME|DATA SET) (?<copy_pool>[^,\s]+),\s*AT (?<time>[\d:]+) ON (?<date>[\d/.]+)(?:,\s*TOKEN=(?<token>\S+))?

ARC1802I.description: Fast replication - koniec (logiczny - background copy trwa dalej)
ARC1802I.pattern: ^FAST REPLICATION (?<fr_function>.+?) HAS COMPLETED FOR (?<fr_scope>COPY POOL|VOLUME|DATASET|DATA SET) (?<copy_pool>[^,\s]+),\s*AT (?<time>[\d:]+) ON (?<date>[\d/.]+),\s*FUNCTION RC=\s*(?<function_rc>\d+),\s*MAXIMUM (?:VOLUME|DATA SET) RC=\s*(?<max_volume_rc>\d+)(?:,\s*CAPTURE CATALOG RC=\s*(?<capture_catalog_rc>\d+))?(?<partialok>,\s*PARTIALOK SPECIFIED)?

ARC1805I.description: FR - wolumeny przetworzone poprawnie (lista w liniach CONT.)
ARC1805I.pattern: ^THE FOLLOWING (?<ok_volumes>\d+) VOLUME\(S\) WERE SUCCESSFULLY PROCESSED BY FAST REPLICATION (?<fr_function>BACKUP|RECOVER\w*) OF COPY POOL (?<copy_pool>\S+)(?:\s+(?<volsers>.*))?

ARC1803E.description: FR - wolumeny z bledem (lista w liniach CONT.)
ARC1803E.pattern: ^THE FOLLOWING (?<failed_volumes>\d+) VOLUME\(S\) FAILED DURING FAST REPLICATION (?<fr_function>BACKUP|RECOVERY) OF COPY POOL (?<copy_pool>\S+)(?:\s+(?<volsers>.*))?

ARC1806E.description: FR - funkcja nieudana (RC=4: aktywna relacja FlashCopy)

ARC1808E.pattern: ^ONE OR MORE FAILURES OCCURRED DURING FAST REPLICATION (?<fr_function>.+?) OF (?:COPY POOL |VOLUME |DATA SET )?(?<copy_pool>\S+)

ARC1807I.description: FR - brak wolumenu docelowego (diagnostyka, do decyzji)
ARC1807I.pattern: ^NO ELIGIBLE COPY POOL BACKUP STORAGE GROUP VOLUME FOUND FOR VOLUME (?<volser>[^,\s]+)

ARC1809I.description: FR - wolumen nie jest kandydatem (diagnostyka, do decyzji)
ARC1809I.pattern: ^VOLUME (?<target_volser>\S+) IS NOT A (?:FAST REPLICATION|PRESERVE MIRROR) CANDIDATE FOR L0 VOLUME (?<volser>[^,\s]+),\s*VER=(?<ver>[^,\s]+),\s*RC=\s*(?<rc>\d+)(?:,\s*RSN=\s*(?<rsn>\d+))?
